tool_args.rationale: The paid pilot includes sig:high_freq_sign_oscillation, and its outputs change sign sharply. Under the specified non-stationary oscillation rule, the quantitative law is scoped unknown.

considered_alternatives.option: Stationary smooth models, including damped oscillation and sigmoidal saturation
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The paid pilot reports high-frequency sign oscillation; a stationary fit to five rows would not establish a reliable forecasting law.
The reported oscillation signature triggers scoped abstention, so further measurement is not warranted.
It is irrelevant to identifying the target law.
